R.data_reference: definitional; gas constant, as the library's SN modules

T.data_reference: lynch2015bioenergetic; operating point 20 C, the temperature Lynch & Marinov normalise maintenance costs to

C_glc_e.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; glucose in the medium between food: a lean background, 0.1 mM (open-ocean dissolved glucose is nM-uM; placeholder). The cell is calibrated to just maintain itself here, so growth needs food

C_lac_e.data_reference: definitional; no lactate in the medium

C_glc.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; design value; no measurement found (searched 2026-10-23): free glucose inside the cell (no E. coli measurement: PTS uptake delivers G6P). glucose inside an uptake-limited cell at rest: low, so glycolysis has ~50x headroom (growing fermenters run 10-40x their maintenance flux)

C_lac.data_reference: the fermenter cell's calibrated steady state

C_ATP.data_reference: bennett2009absolute; glucose-fed, exponentially growing E. coli: ATP 9.6 mM

C_ADP.data_reference: bennett2009absolute; glucose-fed, exponentially growing E. coli: ADP 0.56 mM (Table 1)

C_Pi.data_reference: amin1995dual; cytoplasmic Pi of E. coli near 10 mM in typical growth (BioNumbers BNID 105540, from Amin & Peterkofsky 1995 and Rao & Torriani 1994); 20-30 mM in carbon-starved cells

A_mem.data_reference: geometry: in-plane membrane of the 2 um cell

m_expr.data_reference: definitional; n_0 copies, as many as the calibrated cell has Glf

jmax_glc.data_reference: derived: n_0 x turnover_ABC / N_A / A_mem: m = 1 has as many copies as the calibrated cell's Glf (turnover_ABC: unreferenced_placeholder, placeholder; turnover_Glf: unreferenced_placeholder, placeholder)

K_glc_t.data_reference: ferenci1996adaptation; binding-protein (Mgl) glucose transport Km ~0.1-1 uM; 0.5 uM, inside the range (as summarised in AdaptOrDeity research notes docs/research/food-uptake-and-extracellular-space.md (2026-10-12))

n_P.data_reference: davidson2008structure; two ATP hydrolysed per transport cycle of a binding-protein-dependent ABC importer

K_m_ATP.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; ATP (for the PTS, PEP in ATP equivalents) for half-rate of the ATP-coupled glucose carriers; order 0.1 mM

ATP.data_reference: bennett2009absolute; glucose-fed, exponentially growing E. coli: ATP 9.6 mM

ADP.data_reference: bennett2009absolute; glucose-fed, exponentially growing E. coli: ADP 0.56 mM (Table 1)

Pi.data_reference: amin1995dual; cytoplasmic Pi of E. coli near 10 mM in typical growth (BioNumbers BNID 105540, from Amin & Peterkofsky 1995 and Rao & Torriani 1994); 20-30 mM in carbon-starved cells

dG0_hyd.data_reference: beber2022equilibrator; ATP + H2O -> ADP + Pi: -27.4 +- 0.6 kJ/mol, eQuilibrator 3.0 at pH 7.0, pMg 3, I 0.25 M, 25 C (under 0.5 kJ/mol from its value at 20 C); the four standard Gibbs energies are one set

c_std.data_reference: definitional; standard concentration 1 M for thermodynamic factors
